entities.summary: Loredana Elena Toma is a Romanian weightlifter, two time World Champion and six time European Champion competing in the 58 kg and 63 kg categories until 2018 and 64 kg starting in 2018 after the International Weightlifting Federation reorganized the categories. She now competes at the 71kg category.
